cards.card_text: Then Isaiah tells why: "For the LORD is our Judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our King."

cards.card_text: James says there is only one Lawgiver and Judge.
cards.verse_text: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy.
